title: Prospective pilot study of L-dopa treatment in patients with a neurodevelopmental disorder linked to a pathogenic variant of the CTNNB1 gene
official: Prospective pilot study of L-dopa treatment in patients with a neurodevelopmental disorder linked to a pathogenic variant of the CTNNB1 gene
summary: Main objective: Evaluate the effect of treatment on patients' motor skills by assessing their motor skills before and after treatment with the 88-item Gross Motor Function Measure (GMFM-88).
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Ages 1 to 15 inclusive
2. Carrier of a pathogenic variant of CTNNB1.
3. Patient presenting with dystonia.
4. Patient willing to comply with the contraception requirements outlined in the protocol
Exclusion criteria:
1. Contraindication to treatment with L-dopa and carbidopa or one of its excipients
2. Current treatment with L-dopa, dopamine agonist or dopamine blocker,
3. Failure to obtain informed consent signed by both parents or legal guardians, and to obtain the child's assent if possible.
4. Patient not enrolled in or benefiting from a social security scheme
5. Person participating in another research project with an exclusion period still in progress
6. Patient presenting with a gastro-duodenal ulcer.
7. Patient presenting with open-angle glaucoma
8. Patient presenting with orthostatic hypotension
9. Person who is pregnant or who wishes to become pregnant within 12 months after inclusion.
